Ice Spice, whose real name is Isis Isis Gaston, is an American rapper who grew up in the Bronx, New York. She gained massive viral popularity in late 2022 with her break-out hit “Munch (Feat),” which blew up on TikTok and instantly established her signature relaxed, conversational delivery over heavy Bronx drill beats.

Known for her distinct ginger curly hair and catchy hooks, she quickly capitalized on her initial viral success with follow-up hits like “In Ha Mood” and high-profile collaborations with major artists, including Nicki Minaj on “Princess Diana” and Taylor Swift on a remix of “Karma.” She dropped her debut project, the *Like..?* EP, in early 2023, followed by her debut full-length studio album *Y2K!*, solidifying her position as one of the most prominent mainstream figures in modern rap.
